answer: Contact the Plover release custodian. The duty roster names Asha Venn as the active release custodian (Eli Park is retired). Before resuming Plover EU telemetry export, reconcile the export offsets and obtain incident lead approval. The roster names Koen Li as the incident lead on rotation.
limitations: The duty roster was last updated 2026-10-24, about a month before today (2026-11-25), so the named people may have changed; confirm current assignments before acting. The runbook says the US restart path does not use the EU procedure, and the US suspension contact (Ren Sol) does not apply to EU. The Plover-Sandbox and Plover-Legacy pages describe different products with different custodians, retention, and procedures, and were not used. The Plover-Sandbox export page adds a credential-rotation step, but that applies to Plover-Sandbox only, and no Plover (non-sandbox) page in the corpus mentions it.
